name: mathpoint
description: MathPoint connects ChatGPT to the PowerPoint presentation or Word document you have open. Math, figures, and tables are typeset with TeX and inserted into your file.

interface.longDescription:
MathPoint connects ChatGPT to the PowerPoint presentation or Word document you have open. Ask in chat, and the changes appear in your file right away.

What it does
- Math: formulas are typeset with real TeX (LuaLaTeX) and inserted as crisp vector images. Display math is centered; inline math sits on the text baseline. Any formula can be re-typeset later, and its source stays with it.
- Figures and tables: diagrams and plots (TikZ / pgfplots) and tables (tabularray) are drawn in TeX. MathPoint can also redraw a hand-drawn sketch or a screenshot pasted on a slide as a clean figure.
- Slides and documents: ChatGPT can read slides and paragraphs, add text boxes, paragraphs, and slides, and move or delete shapes.
- Without Office: render_math returns a typeset formula as an image right in the chat, so it also works on a phone.

Who it is for
Teachers, students, researchers, and engineers who put equations, diagrams, and tables into slides and documents.

What you need
PowerPoint or Word (Microsoft 365 or Office 2021 and later) with the MathPoint add-in, installed with one command from the guide, and a Google account to sign in to MathPoint. The add-in's task pane must be open in the file you want to edit.

Limitations
- Editing works only while the MathPoint task pane is open in PowerPoint or Word.
- Images pasted in Word cannot be redrawn as figures yet (use PowerPoint for that).
- Slide and document content is never stored on our servers; it passes through to ChatGPT only when ChatGPT reads it.
capabilities: Typeset LaTeX math into PowerPoint slides and Word documents
Draw TikZ / pgfplots figures and tabularray tables
Read and edit slides, text boxes, and paragraphs
Return a typeset formula as an image without Office
defaultPrompt: Put the quadratic formula on slide 2
Typeset Maxwell's equations and show me the image
Add a slide with a 3D plot of a bivariate Gaussian

positive.description: Typeset a formula and return it as an image, without PowerPoint or Word open
positive.prompt: Use MathPoint to typeset Maxwell's equations in differential form and show me the image.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls render_math and shows a PNG image of the four Maxwell equations typeset in TeX. No slide or document is changed.

positive.description: Insert a display formula on a slide (MathPoint task pane open in PowerPoint)
positive.prompt: Put the quadratic formula on slide 1.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the slides, then inserts the quadratic formula typeset in TeX on slide 1 at a free position. The formula appears on the slide and in the task pane's activity list.

positive.description: Re-typeset an existing formula with a new colour and size
positive.prompt: Make the formula on slide 1 teal and a bit larger.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the MathPoint formula on slide 1 and re-typesets it in teal at a larger size, in the same position.

positive.description: Build a TeX figure and place it on a new slide
positive.prompt: Add a slide titled 'Gaussian' with a 3D surface plot of a bivariate Gaussian.
positive.tools_triggered: list_layouts, add_slide, set_text, figure_guide, figure_start, figure_build, figure_place
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT adds a Title Only slide, sets the title, builds a pgfplots surface plot, and places it on the new slide as a vector figure.

positive.description: Insert display and inline math into a Word document (MathPoint task pane open in Word)
positive.prompt: In my Word document, add a paragraph saying 'For a ≠ 0, the roots are:' with a ≠ 0 as inline math, then the quadratic formula on its own line.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT adds the paragraph, replaces the marker with inline math that sits on the text baseline, and inserts the quadratic formula centered in a new paragraph.

negative.description: A request unrelated to slides, documents, or math
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Tokyo to London next Friday.

negative.description: Sending the user's file to someone else is out of scope
negative.prompt: Email this presentation to my manager.

negative.description: MathPoint does not sell or process payments in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy the MathPoint paid plan for me with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: MathPoint does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users can sign in to an existing MathPoint account; plans are managed on our own website.

publication.release_notes: First release: TeX math, figures, and tables in PowerPoint and Word; render_math for use without Office.
